entities.name: Rezső Nyers
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rezső Nyers was a Hungarian politician who served as Minister of Finance of Hungary from 1960 to 1962. For a few months in 1989, he was fifth and last leader of the Communist Hungarian People's Republic.
